question: 一共有多少订单
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 订单总数 FROM orders

question: 各订单状态的订单数量分布
sql: SELECT status AS 订单状态, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: 每个月的订单量是多少
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 每个城市的订单数量排名
sql: SELECT u.city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY 订单数 DESC

question: 销量最好的商品有哪些
sql: SELECT p.name AS 商品名, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 销量 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各品类的销售额是多少
sql: SELECT c.name AS 品类, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS 销售额 FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

question: 退款订单的总金额是多少
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 退款金额 FROM orders WHERE status = '已退款'

question: 女性用户一共有多少人
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 女性用户数 FROM users WHERE gender = '女'

question: 平台的平均客单价
sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS 平均客单价 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款'

question: 消费最高的10个用户是谁
sql: SELECT u.name AS 用户, SUM(o.amount) AS 消费总额 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status != '已退款' GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 每个月新增多少注册用户
sql: SELECT strftime(registered_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 新增用户 FROM users GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 库存不足100件的商品有多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 商品数 FROM products WHERE stock < 100

question: 2024年全年收入是多少
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 年收入 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND status != '已退款'

question: 每个季度的订单量分布
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM created_at) AS 年份, EXTRACT(quarter FROM created_at) AS 季度, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders GROUP BY 年份, 季度 ORDER BY 年份, 季度

question: 至少购买过2次的用户数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 复购用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)

question: 一共有多少种商品
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 商品种类数 FROM products

question: 已完成订单占全部订单的比例
sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = '已完成' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS 完成占比 FROM orders

question: 北京的订单量是多少
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 北京订单数 FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.city = '北京'

question: 每笔订单平均多少钱
sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS 平均订单金额 FROM orders WHERE status != '已退款'

question: 商品的平均定价是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS 平均定价 FROM products

question: 每个月的退款订单数量变化
sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 退款订单数 FROM orders WHERE status = '已退款' GROUP BY 月份 ORDER BY 月份

question: 各个城市分别有多少用户
sql: SELECT city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 用户数 FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY 用户数 DESC

question: 卖得最贵的商品是什么
sql: SELECT name AS 商品名, price AS 定价 FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个品类的商品库存总量
sql: SELECT c.name AS 品类, SUM(p.stock) AS 总库存 FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 总库存 DESC
